label: Geometric series definition
subgoals: Identify first term a and ratio r

visual.title: A ratio below one converges
visual.caption: Each term is half the one before. The partial sums climb toward 1 but never pass it, which is what a ratio below one guarantees.

predict.question: Σ (1/2)^k from k = 1 converges to:
predict.explain: The first term is 1/2 and the ratio is 1/2, so the sum is a/(1 − r) = (1/2)/(1/2) = 1.
